intent: Polish CSS width, padding and button styling for the existing history drawer to match the account detail drawer

triage.reason: intent and paths both match the light lane
escalation_triggers: touches auth, permissions, billing, security, database, API routes, deployment, package manifests, or SpecNav internals
adds a new user-facing workflow, page, module, data flow, or cross-component behavior
touches more than three intended paths or more than ten production files after edits
requires product decisions that are not already expressible in one acceptance assertion

acceptance.statement: In modern layout, the history list/editor/review/confirmation uses the same 640px-or-viewport drawer width, header/body/footer spacing, title scale and button appearance as account detail. Narrow screens retain usable controls and a wrapping timeline without horizontal scrolling; classic styling, interaction and persistence are unchanged.

Use only CSS to match the outer account timeline date font (12px), status font (11px), date height (27px), capsule padding and colors. Retain clear insertion/removal, visible focus, valid/invalid/disabled/removed states, record order, existing interactions and classic appearance. Compact timeline targets are at least 24px, with 44px targets for coarse pointers; mobile footer controls remain 44px.

Use CSS grid to pair existing connectors and stages across multiple rows without HTML or JavaScript changes. No timeline horizontal overflow at 320/390/1024/1440 widths; added, removed and long translated text wraps visibly without clipping, preserving record order and all draft controls.

tasks.text: Align modern history drawer CSS with existing account detail, then check desktop/mobile, theme/locale, draft/review/confirmation and unchanged classic behavior using synthetic data.

Refine timeline typography and control sizing following the owner's two screenshots, then validate appearance, layout, keyboard, draft-only insert/remove/restore and existing regressions using synthetic data.

Replace the prior larger scrolling timeline style with outer-detail sizing and wrapping grid rows using only CSS; verify normal, long, removed, inserted and readonly/busy states, themes, locales and keyboard/pointer draft actions offline.

user_test.case: Owner visual review of the compact multiline history timeline and aligned drawer/buttons. This does not assert live persistence testing.
